review_scope: Paired technical review of all 23 prescribed physical-surface stations. Compared a second historic baseline and matched named material bindings for five rooms or props with visibly different exposure. Dim and obstructed stations retain their stated limits. The prior bodega-specific lighting views were reused from the producer, with their frame hashes and 15 relevant source inputs checked.

images.observation: The table, floor boards and wall paint remain readable under the pendant, with the same colorful residue on the floor.
The lamp pool crosses the grout lines and bath curtain without a new discontinuity. The strong circular beam is present in both views.
The bright doorway, floor grain, radiator and furnishings remain visible around the standing resident.
Floor board seams, window light and bookshelf remain legible at the same camera angle.
The cabinet faces and sink retain their shape and response. The lower wall subtitle differs between captures, and the irregular wall lighting is present in both.
The pressure dial, contrasting boiler panels and pipe silhouette remain visible in the dark service room.
Shelf fronts, chair and doorway survive the changed exposure with visible wood grain.
Tile courses, pipe and cistern edges remain intact at the close camera position.
As on main, the camera faces a dim brick bay. The joints are visible, while the lift fittings are obscured.
The open-door cabinet face reads cooler in the new still. All 34 fuse-panel draw material bindings match the previous inventory.
The seated view is heavily obscured by the bar furniture in both frames. The slab of tabletop and visible trim register without a new seam.
The cat and wall still have low exposure. Its silhouette and the shelf edge remain visible.
Foreground wood hides part of the standing station in both images. The visible bar wall and trim remain continuous.
The candidate frame lights the mail slots more evenly. All 14 draw material bindings for the mail bank match main.
The near radiator, valve, slatted blind and adjacent table read without an obvious new surface defect.
The guard, floor trim, roof sign and lamp remain readable along the stair edge.
The exterior tank, steel rail and masonry continue to render against the dawn skyline.
The terminal enclosure appears cooler under the room lighting. All 10 signal-terminal draw material bindings match main.
The tile seam rhythm and cistern margins remain continuous at the close service angle.
The colored residue and foreground scene lighting remain visible and separate from the radiator and floor.
The candidate leaves more of the curtain, table and radiator in amber light. The tentacle silhouette and lit surface detail are present.
The toaster and cups read cooler in the candidate frame, with the crumbs and patterns still visible. All 292 toaster draw material bindings match main.
The wall falls darker in the new frame while the dial remains visible. All 287 watch-station draw material bindings match main.
